title: Tracker Service Configuration
description: Main configuration file for Tracker Service.

port.description: Broker port (typically 1883 for TCP, 8883 for TLS)

insecure.description: Disable TLS for unencrypted connections (development only)

tls.description: TLS certificate settings for secure connections

client_key_path.description: Path to client private key file

manager.description: Manager REST API connection for fetching scene configurations. Required when scenes.source is 'api'.

auth_path.description: Path to JSON auth file containing user and password keys

ca_cert_path.description: Path to CA certificate for HTTPS verification.

ntp.description: NTP server connection for clock offset correction.

server.description: NTP server hostname or IP (e.g. 'pool.ntp.org'). When set, the tracker periodically queries this server to correct for local clock drift before evaluating message lag. Leave empty or omit to rely on the OS clock discipline (chronyd/ntpd).

sync_interval_s.description: How often to re-synchronize the NTP offset in seconds.

otlp.description: OpenTelemetry collector connection (shared by metrics and tracing). Note: Secure (TLS) connections are not yet supported.

insecure.description: Use insecure (non-TLS) connection. Must be true (secure not yet supported).

healthcheck.description: HTTP healthcheck server settings for Kubernetes probes

port.description: Port for healthcheck HTTP server (/healthz, /readyz endpoints)

schema_validation.description: Enable JSON schema validation for incoming and outgoing MQTT messages. Disable for performance in production if profiling shows message parsing is a bottleneck.

metrics.description: OpenTelemetry metrics export settings. Requires infrastructure.otlp to be configured.

tracing.description: OpenTelemetry distributed tracing settings. Requires infrastructure.otlp to be configured.

export_interval_s.description: Batch span processor schedule delay in seconds

max_lag_s.description: Maximum lag allowed for MQTT detection frames in seconds. Frames arriving with greater lag will be dropped.

max_unreliable_time_s.description: Time in seconds before a track becomes reliable and is published. Filters out spurious detections.

non_measurement_time_dynamic_s.description: Time in seconds before deleting a track for a dynamic (moving) object that stopped receiving measurements.

non_measurement_time_static_s.description: Time in seconds before deleting a track for a static object that stopped receiving measurements.

time_chunking_rate_fps.description: Rate at which the tracker processes batched detections from all cameras. Higher values reduce latency but increase CPU usage.

max_workers.description: DoS protection: maximum worker threads (one per scene+category). Limits resource exhaustion from unexpected categories.

method.description: Association metric: position_mahalanobis (default, UKF predicted covariance gate) or euclidean (legacy meter gate).

gate_probability.description: Chi-squared gate probability for position_mahalanobis (2 DOF). Ignored for euclidean.

max_radius_m.description: Euclidean distance threshold (m) or hard Mahalanobis ceiling (m). Default 10 m supports the position_mahalanobis chi-squared gate; use ~2 m when method is euclidean.

scenes.description: Scene configuration source. Use 'api' (default) to fetch scenes dynamically from Manager REST API (requires infrastructure.manager). Use 'file' to load scenes from an external JSON file.

source.description: Configuration source: file (from JSON file) or api (from Manager REST API)

file_path.description: Path to scene definitions JSON file (relative to config file directory or absolute). Required when source=file.
